attempt: Complete dusk chores and leave the wolf seated safely.
interference: Three unexplained red wool blocks interrupt an otherwise authored routine.
change: He dismisses them and descends towards an unfamiliar purple glow.
purpose: Establish bond, geography and the protagonist’s control habit.
reveal: The private world contains one detail he cannot confidently claim.
visual: The wolf sits; timber stair passes above a separated lava glow.
audio: Quiet tools, wolf panting and a distant portal hum.

attempt: Identify the portal builder through physical inspection.
interference: No access history or inventory explanation accounts for the completed frame.
change: Familiar footing and a reversed torch deepen rather than solve the contradiction.
purpose: Define the title mystery and fair clue language.
reveal: The frame was deliberately constructed by someone who knows this cave.
visual: Hand checks empty chest, cobblestone foot and left-wall torch.

attempt: Test the only remaining path by entering.
interference: Fear of losing the known world competes with curiosity and authorship.
change: He crosses and emerges beside an ash-filled version of the ravine.
purpose: Make the disruption a protagonist decision rather than an abduction.
reveal: The portal’s destination is temporal or imitative, not the expected Nether.
visual: Matched cave exit changes from dusk and intact blocks to dawn and ruin.
audio: Portal transition followed by abruptly sparse ambience.

attempt: Reach the homestead and find the wolf.
interference: Fire damage and missing blocks erase the familiar route; the pen is empty.
change: He reads the landscape as a future in which everything living may be gone.
purpose: Attach personal stakes to spatial mystery.
reveal: This is the same homestead after a specific destruction.
visual: Matched doorway, collapsed roof, open pen and untouched stone drain.
audio: Narration shifts from mapping to restrained dread.

attempt: Catch the distant figure who may know what happened.
interference: The figure uses the ridge to conceal the wolf and stays beyond identification range.
change: A two-crouch check and left-wall torch register as oddly familiar before the figure disappears.
purpose: Seed self-identity and provide an active pursuit.
reveal: The apparent stranger knows the protagonist’s navigation habits.
visual: Distant silhouette crosses crest; torch appears after two crouches.
audio: Footsteps, one wolf sound masked by wind and no second voice.

attempt: Use the portal to return and attempt a better outcome.
interference: The ridge trail ends and no other route explains the changed world.
change: The crossing ejects him into a bare cave before the frame exists.
reveal: The anomaly has a fixed event route and can exit where no frame yet stands.
visual: Portal surface collapses to bare stone behind him.
audio: Transition cuts to younger mining sounds above.

attempt: Date the world state and find an exit.
interference: Missing portal blocks and undamaged landmarks precede every event he remembers.
change: He sees his younger self beside the living wolf and accepts that this is his past.
purpose: Separate one timeline from alternate-world interpretations.
reveal: Two personal states of the protagonist coexist at one world time.
visual: Foreground cover frames younger self and wolf on the west rim.
audio: Narration names observation, not a theory of repeats.

attempt: Warn or move the wolf without revealing himself.
interference: The younger self approaches and a complete sign would expose outside agency.
change: He lays three local red wool blocks, recognises the opening marker and abandons the arrowhead.
purpose: Prove that intervention forms remembered history through character choice.
reveal: The apparently forgotten marker was his own later warning.
visual: Three blocks point vaguely towards the eastern drain; the fourth remains in his hand.
audio: Approaching footsteps interrupt narration and construction sounds.

attempt: Find a reliable way to give his younger self useful foreknowledge.
interference: Direct warning risks refusal; no exit frame exists; the discovery time is approaching.
change: Comparing the bare wall with his memory, he decides to become the builder.
purpose: Convert recognition into a costly commitment.
reveal: The portal was not waiting for him independently; his choice completes its cause.
visual: He marks the remembered footing and looks from lava shelf to frame site.
audio: A restrained causal recap ends on renewed mining sound.

attempt: Obtain enough ordinary obsidian before the younger self descends.
interference: The lava shelf is awkward to reach and time pressure favours expedient staging.
change: Water cooling creates the odd cobblestone foot while spruce staging closes the gap to the timber stair.
purpose: Give materials linear origins and plant the destruction cause.
reveal: Every mysterious construction detail comes from a practical decision.
visual: Water meets lava; obsidian is mined; spruce crosses the formerly empty gap.
audio: Tool rhythm accelerates under distant younger-self movement.

attempt: Reconstruct and light the exact remembered frame.
interference: The last blocks force him to choose speed over removing the staging.
change: The portal activates with the asymmetry and reversed torch intact.
purpose: Pay off the builder mystery through visible action.
reveal: The protagonist made the portal from local blocks while copying his memory of it.
visual: Opening portal composition is repeated from the opposite side.
audio: The portal sound returns before narration confirms recognition.

attempt: Ensure the younger self enters without disrupting him.
interference: He can reveal himself, dismantle the frame or preserve the only rescue path he knows.
change: He chooses silence, watches entry and then notices smoke rising along the stair.
purpose: Make concealment an accountable decision and launch the physical climax.
reveal: The opening hesitation was watched by the builder himself.
visual: Matched opening blocking; first ember appears on the spruce staging.
audio: Younger footsteps and portal transit give way to fire crackle.

attempt: Keep the fire from reproducing the ruin.
interference: Connected timber has created separated fronts and one movable water source cannot cover them.
change: He recognises his staging as the origin while a collapse exposes the trapped wolf’s distress.
purpose: Turn causal guilt into a forced allocation of action.
reveal: No anomaly caused the destruction; his expedient construction completed the route.
visual: Water moves across roof sections while fire climbs from the undercroft.
audio: Fire, breaking blocks and the first clear wolf cry overtake narration.

attempt: Reach and release the wolf before the pen is cut off.
interference: The safe yard route is burning and the water source is still defending the house.
change: He abandons the roof, routes water through the stone drain, opens the pen and releases the wolf.
purpose: Resolve the central question through a resource-backed value choice.
reveal: The future’s empty pen did not show the whole outcome.
visual: Wet stone lane, opened gate, wolf standing and following as roof burns behind.
audio: Narration falls away for the choice; wolf and water carry the moment.

attempt: Leave with the wolf while preserving the journey his earlier self must complete.
interference: The portal flares and the arriving self can see the ridge but not below it.
change: He hides the wolf, recreates the silhouette, waits for the crossing, extinguishes the portal and walks on.
purpose: Unite figure identity, wolf survival, fixed outcome and closing image.
reveal: The feared stranger and successful rescuer are the same person.
visual: Reverse ridge angle reveals wolf; final frame mirrors the opening departure.
audio: Two crouches, torch placement, portal dousing and first-light ambience.
